heroHeadline: 31 Days to Kickoff — Messi Confirmed in Argentina Provisional Squad; Dybala Out; All 48 Nations Submit to FIFA Today
heroSubtitle: Argentina publicly released its 55-man preliminary World Cup roster on May 11 — FIFA's provisional squad deadline day. Lionel Messi (38) leads the list, joined by Lautaro Martínez, Julián Álvarez, Alexis Mac Allister, Enzo Fernández, and Alejandro Garnacho (returning after absence since September 2024). Six Qatar 2022 World Cup winners are absent: Paulo Dybala (Roma, 40 caps — omitted), Ángel Di María (retired), Franco Armani (retired), Ángel Correa, and Alejandro 'Papu' Gómez among others. Final 26-man squad due May 30; FIFA publishes all 48 squads simultaneously on June 2. Today is FIFA's provisional deadline for all 48 nations to submit 35–55 player lists — clubs' release obligations begin May 25. Sweden announces their squad tomorrow (May 12). France names 26 players May 14 (Deschamps in Paris) — Mbappé's hamstring fitness remains the tournament's biggest pre-tournament concern; no competitive minutes since El Clásico exclusion May 10. Brazil's Ancelotti announces May 18 (Rio) — Neymar in provisional squad, must survive final cut. England confirmed May 22 (Tuchel at Wembley). USMNT May 26 (live event at The Rooftop at Pier 17 NYC on FOX Sports). Iran: no US visas issued to any Iranian player or staff as of May 11 — 10-point ultimatum issued May 9 remains the active framework. FIFA–Iran Zurich meeting May 20 is the last diplomatic channel before the June 1 final squad deadline. Iran's squad due to depart for Turkey training camp May 15 (contingent on visas). CNN published a 'one month to go' feature today noting Iran participation is described as 'very likely.' 31 days to kickoff at Estadio Azteca.
